rationale: All three lenses ran with a spec present and no new blocking defect survived triage. The acceptance lens marked four rows partial; each rests only on owner-accepted limits (D-1, D-2, D-5) or on backend behaviour that is out of CLI scope, so they are recorded as accepted rather than as findings. Deferred (not blocking): synthetic assistant line without a usage block would lift the idle-reopen suppression (verified live, but 0 of 45 real synthetic lines lack usage), start-pass fallback on lock failure re-announces a resume, uuid-less copied records (titles) are not excluded from the summary, doc wording on idle PostCompact state, stale task artifacts and review-process comments in source. Dismissed (about 20): D-1..D-5 restatements, SessionEnd silent by design, empty transcript_path, file growing between stat and read (retried), state size, plan/actual-complexity drift, and test-gap or cosmetic items.
